text: Can you pull together every ticket number on Quarrendon Freight Lines you can find across Moss's notes? List each with where it comes from. Putting it in the weekly notes.
reply_text:
I found two Quarrendon Freight Lines ticket numbers in Moss's notes and sent you the list in our DM:

1. #PD-4492, from "Moss: Sunday prep for Ruth" (5 Oct 2025, teams/team-north/digests/2025-10-05-north-sunday.md). Thea Ramaswell logged it on 4 Oct 2025 because drivers at the Eau Claire yard weren't getting their SMS bay assignments. Support fixed it that evening and Thea confirmed the fix on 5 Oct. The note also asks for the kiosk logs to be archived before the 14 Oct maintenance window, which is today.
2. #4419, from "Moss: North cheat sheet" (teams/team-north/digests/north-account-cheatsheet.md). Thea logged it because the barcode scanners at Door 14 weren't reading trailer tags on third shift. It was escalated to tier-2 support. The cheat sheet has no date, so I can't tell how current this one is.

I read all six of Moss's notes in the shared files. Two other notes mention Quarrendon Freight Lines but give no ticket numbers. The other numbers in Moss's notes (#4409, #4412 and FR-882) belong to the Marrow accounts, not this one.

When you write it up, don't mix this account up with Quarendon Freightways (one "r"). Moss's cheat sheet notes that it isn't our customer.
